title: Felt wargame extension: zones of control (ZOC)
description: Write ZOC logic in Felt. Functions: in_zoc(state, zone, col, row, player) returns true if cell is adjacent to enemy units. zoc_movement_cost(state, zone, col, row, player) returns extra MP cost for entering ZOC. is_legal validates no ZOC-to-ZOC movement (cannot move directly between two enemy ZOC hexes without passing through friendly-controlled hex).
close_reason: zoc.felt implements in_enemy_zoc, adjacent_enemy_count, is_zoc_to_zoc, zoc_entry_cost, player_zoc_cells. Type-checks cleanly.
